answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ocean of the next round. The wharf of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
